description:
Hi! I'm Diar (15 yo), leading team SpaceScout. I do backend (C++/Python), electronics, and management. Our goal is finding Earth analogs for Moon/Mars missions by systematically analyzing geology, mineralogy, and atmospheric processes to see where analogies work or break down.

Looking for team members:

Python Developers

GIS Analysts  

Designers 

Join SpaceScout to accelerate space exploration
